verdict.rationale: LegalOS is an AI-assisted immigration service that handles sensitive applicant data, so a training opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about AI training data use, opt-outs, or data-usage commitments. The only AI mention is a general reference to 'AI workflows', which says nothing about training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
